summary: Phase 3 (calendar + weather + mind-map study tools) verified end-to-end at http://localhost:3000 (mobile 390x844) with real Firebase login test.arshnaz@example.com. BACKEND: 18/18 pytest pass (9 phase-3 new + 9 attachments regression) — /api/arsh/holidays/au?year=2026&state=NSW returns Australia Day 2026-01-26 and NSW Labour Day 2026-10-05 with region=NSW, does NOT include WA-only 2026-03-02, state='' returns national-only, state='XX' -> 400, second call preserves synced_at (Mongo cache). /api/arsh/weather?lat=-33.87&lon=151.21 -> timezone=Australia/Sydney, current present, hourly.time has 192 entries, daily.time has 8 entries, fetched_at present, second call returns cached=true, lat=200 -> 422. /api/arsh/geocode?q=Sydney returns items with numeric lat/lon; q='a' -> 422. CALENDAR /app/calendar (Jalali mode): month header shows 'مهر ۱۴۰۵ / September ۲۰۲۶', week starts Saturday (ش column first), Mehr 1405 renders 1..30 with today (6 Mehr) circled. Coloured day cells confirmed: month-day-holiday-off=1 (13 Mehr Labour Day), month-day-holiday-occasion=3 (8 مولوی, 13 نیروی انتظامی, 20 حافظ), month-day-holiday-lunar=0 for this month. holiday-legend shows تعطیل / مناسبت / قمری · تقریبی chips. holiday-list contains 'Labour Day … دوشنبه ۱۳ مهر … استرالیا · NSW … تعطیل' as required, plus the Iranian occasions. Tab switch ماهانه / هفتگی / روزانه changes the header ('مناسبت‌های این ماه/هفته/روز') and item count as expected. Clicking a holiday day opens day-sheet-holiday containing 'روز نیروی انتظامی · Labour Day' (both holidays for that day shown). SETTINGS: horizon-settings-btn on /app/buckets opens popover with au-state-select (native <select> — options: '' (فقط سراسری), NSW, VIC, QLD, SA, WA, TAS, ACT, NT; default NSW), week-start-sat and week-start-mon toggles. Switching to national-only ('') removes Labour Day / NSW from the calendar holiday-list (verified: 'Labour' not in text, 'NSW' not in text) — Iranian occasions remain. WEATHER: /app/today shows weather-chip-today; tap opens weather-sheet-today. On first use weather-location-picker appears — weather-use-gps with granted geolocation (Sydney -33.87,151.21) populates weather-day-summary, weather-hourly-list, weather-updated-at ('به‌روزرسانی: ۲۰:۵۲ · ۶ مهر'), weather-refresh, weather-change-location. /app/tomorrow shows weather-chip-tomorrow. /app/buckets horizon-tab-week shows weather-week-strip with 7 cells (days beyond forecast horizon render '–' as specified). MIND MAP: /app/review/pharmacy?tab=mindmap → 'نمای نقشه‌ای' switches to canvas; mindmap-study-tools toolbar visible with mindmap-focus-toggle, mindmap-reveal-toggle, mindmap-reveal-next, mindmap-reveal-reset all present and clickable. Regression: login flow, /app/today, /app/buckets tabs, /app/calendar all render without new console errors (only the pre-existing 'Capacitor plugin ArshnazWidget already registered' warning carried over from prior iterations, and Vite HMR WebSocket noise which is environmental — Vite dev server behind the k8s ingress rewrites ws:// to wss://localhost, unrelated to app code).

integration_issues.issue: After clicking mindmap-reveal-toggle the button's innerText still reads 'تدریجی' rather than the spec label 'بعدی 0/N'. The toggle itself functions (mindmap-reveal-next becomes visible, mindmap-reveal-reset appears), but the visible label used to communicate progress to the user did not update in my run. Please verify whether the label text is rendered inside a sibling element that a getByText on the toolbar cannot see, or whether the state simply didn't toggle in my session.

I could not automate 'tap a node card' from the mobile viewport — my selector `[data-mindmap-node-id]` returned 0 elements even though 496 mindmap-node-wrap-focus wrappers were counted, which strongly suggests the node card's data attribute name differs from what I assumed. Toolbar toggle works and wrappers get the correct focus testID when focus mode is entered; I just cannot confirm the dim/focus swap after tapping a specific non-root node without knowing the correct clickable selector. Main agent should manually verify the tap-to-focus behaviour or share the node-card selector.

Clicks fire without errors. See frontend_issues.integration_issues for label & node-tap open items.
verified_flows.regression_smoke: PASS - login → /app/today (empty state renders), /app/buckets (all horizon-* testIDs), /app/calendar (holiday list + coloured cells), Firestore online, no new console errors beyond the pre-existing Capacitor plugin double-register warning.

action_items: Please verify the visible label of mindmap-reveal-toggle after activation. Spec says it should read 'بعدی 0/N' but my run still saw 'تدریجی'. If the label lives inside a nested span, add a stable testID (e.g. mindmap-reveal-counter) to expose the counter for testing.

Expose a stable selector on the mind-map node card itself (e.g. data-testid='mindmap-node-<id>' or a well-known attribute like data-mindmap-node-id) so tap-to-focus can be exercised deterministically. Currently the wrappers with zero size carry the testID mindmap-node-wrap-*, which the review request even flags as un-clickable — but the card inside has no obvious testID for automation.

Recurring warning 'Capacitor plugin ArshnazWidget already registered. Cannot register plugins twice.' still logged on every page load (carried from previous iterations). Guard the registration with an if-not-registered check.

Vite dev server WebSocket points to 'wss://localhost/?token=…' inside the k8s pod which is refused (net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED). This only affects HMR during automated testing at http://localhost:3000 and is environmental; consider setting VITE server.hmr.host/protocol so HMR uses ws://localhost:3000 to keep the browser console clean during e2e.
critical_code_review_comments: holidays_au.py — proper 7-day Mongo cache with Nager.Date; region filter is correct (national via `global` flag or empty counties list; state via `AU-<STATE>` presence); returns synced_at + stale flag; 502 fallback if network fails and no cache. Nice & tight.

weather.py — key rounded to 2 decimals (~1 km) is a sensible cache granularity; 30-minute freshness; graceful degrade to last cached payload with stale=true when Open-Meteo fails; cached:true only when the current call was served from cache — correct semantic.
server.py registers holidays_router and weather_router under /api/arsh — correct, matches proxy rewrite via Vite; CORS wide-open which is fine for a preview.
MongoDB ObjectId is never leaked: both cache readers project {'_id': 0}.
Both external HTTP calls set a timeout (12s / 10s) so a hung upstream can't wedge FastAPI workers.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL is behind Cloudflare — ALWAYS test the UI at http://localhost:3000 (Vite dev server proxies /api/arsh to localhost:8001). MOBILE viewport 390x844. Use context.grant_permissions(['geolocation'], origin='http://localhost:3000') + context.set_geolocation to satisfy weather-use-gps. Vite HMR WebSocket errors in console are environmental noise — ignore. Each browser_automation call is a fresh context; must re-login per script. au-state-select is a NATIVE <select> — use select_option(value=…) not a radix menu click. Backend tests: `cd /app/backend && EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:8001 pytest tests/ -v` completes in ~1.5s. Mind-map node cards need a discoverable selector before tap-to-focus can be automated — see action_items.
